Welcome to CloudWay 24 Careers—where your journey takes off!
Join one of India’s fastest-growing international airlines and help us redefine the skies with innovation, dedication, and world-class service.

CloudWay 24 isn’t just an airline; it’s a global family that believes in connecting people, cultures, and opportunities through seamless travel experiences. We aspire to excellence in everything we do—whether in the air or on the ground. At CloudWay 24, your career can soar as high as our Dreamliners!

items.text: Inclusive & Diverse: We celebrate diversity and believe every team member contributes to our collective success.
Customer-Focused: Delivering memorable experiences is at the heart of our mission.
Innovation-Driven: Encourage new ideas and provide opportunities to redefine air travel.
Team Spirit: Strong collaboration between cockpit, cabin crew, ground staff, engineers, and corporate teams.
Competitive Compensation
Medical & Wellness Programs
Travel Benefits (for you & family)
SkyPoints 24 membership perks
Learning & Development Programs
Performance Bonuses & Rewards
Flexible Schedules & Remote Work Opportunities (selected roles)
Employee Assistance Programs
Modern offices at our Mumbai HQ and airport hubs
Open communication & transparent leadership
A culture of recognition and respect

blocks.text: We’re always searching for passionate professionals in:

items.text: Cabin Crew (Flight Attendants)
Pilots (Wide-body & Narrow-body)
Ground Operations
Customer Service & Call Center
Engineering & Maintenance
IT & Digital Solutions
Sales & Marketing
Finance & Human Resources
Airport Lounge Staff

blocks.text: Explore Latest Openings → (https://cloudway24.com/careers)
With operations spanning Asia, Europe, North America, and the Middle East, every role at CloudWay 24 offers global exposure and the chance to be part of something extraordinary.

“CloudWay 24 is about growth, learning, and making meaningful connections. Every day brings new challenges, and I love being part of a team that supports each other.”
— Meera S., Senior Cabin Crew

“From day one, the SkyPoints 24 program and travel perks made me feel I was part of a global community.”
— Arjun N., IT & Innovation Lead

Welcome to CloudWay 24 – where your career takes flight! Join our Administration Department to shape the backbone of a leading international airline. We’re seeking dedicated professionals eager to ensure seamless operations, continuous growth, and ultimate customer satisfaction.

items.text: Location: Mumbai (Head Office)
Working Hours: Full-Time (Mon–Fri, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM) + Occasional weekends during peak operational periods
Educational Qualifications:
MBA or Master’s in Business Administration/Public Administration or equivalent
Minimum 7–10 years’ experience in administration, preferably in the aviation or transport sector
Package: ₹30–40 LPA (based on experience) + Performance Bonus + Benefits
Roles & Responsibilities:
Oversee daily administrative operations across all departments
Develop and implement policies for office management, procurement, and compliance
Coordinate with airport authorities and regulatory bodies
Lead a team of junior managers and executives
Streamline processes for cost efficiency and operational excellence
Location: New Delhi / Bengaluru
Working Hours: Full-Time (Mon–Fri, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM)
Educational Qualifications:
Bachelor’s/Master’s in Business Administration or related field
2–5 years’ experience in administration/office management
Package: ₹12–18 LPA + Benefits
Roles & Responsibilities:
Support the Senior Manager in day-to-day administrative tasks
Manage documentation, facilities, and office supplies
Liaise between staff and management for smooth workflows
Assist in organizing meetings, reports, and logistics
Location: Mumbai / Bengaluru / New Delhi
Working Hours: Full-Time (Mon–Sat, 9:00 AM–5:30 PM)
Educational Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration / Commerce / Arts
Freshers or candidates with up to 2 years’ relevant experience
Package: ₹6–9 LPA + Benefits
Roles & Responsibilities:
Handle office coordination, record-keeping, and basic administrative support
Assist in vendor management, travel bookings, and reimbursements
Maintain administrative databases and prepare standard reports
Provide general support to visitors and staff
Location: Mumbai (Primary), with periodic travel to Delhi / Bengaluru
Working Hours: Full-Time (Shift basis; flexible, including weekends in case of urgent needs)
Educational Qualifications:
Bachelor’s in Engineering (Mechanical / Aeronautical / Electrical)
1–3 years of experience in airline fleet or asset management preferred
Package: ₹10–15 LPA + Allowances
Roles & Responsibilities:
Coordinate with Maintenance and Technical teams for fleet scheduling
Maintain comprehensive records of fleet usage, service, and compliance
Support procurement and inventory of spare parts and consumables
Generate reports on fleet performance and cost analysis for management
Working Hours: As per flying roster; typically, flight duty periods with adequate rest per DGCA/EASA/FAA regulations.
Location: Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru (assigned base after selection)
Educational Qualifications:
Minimum: 10+2 (Physics & Mathematics mandatory)
Valid Commercial Pilot License (CPL) issued by DGCA/ICAO member state
English Language Proficiency: Level 4 or above
Package: INR 15-18 lakhs per annum + benefits
Roles & Responsibilities:
Undergo training on Boeing 787/Airbus A350/A380 as allocated.
Assist in pre-flight checks, planning and cockpit preparation.
Comply with all SOPs, safety, and regulatory standards.
Develop and maintain proficiency through simulator and classroom training.
Shadow certified pilots and support flight operations.
Working Hours: Roster-based flying shifts; as per regulatory limits and airline scheduling.
Location: Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru (assigned base)
Educational Qualifications:
Valid ATPL or Frozen ATPL
Minimum total flying hours as specified by DGCA/ICAO for type
Current type rating (Boeing 787 Dreamliner / Airbus A350 / Airbus A380)
Package: INR 38-48 lakhs per annum + bonuses & benefits
Roles & Responsibilities:
Operate flights under Captain’s command.
Assist Captain in safe aircraft operation, navigation, and communication.
Execute flight duties as per CloudWay 24 and international standards.
Participate in recurrent training and skill assessments.
Working Hours: Flight duty as per roster, including long-haul sectors.
Location: Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru (assigned base)
Educational Qualifications:
Valid ATPL
Significant experience as First Officer (min. 2000+ hours, at least 1000 hours on type preferred)
Current type rating (B787/A350/A380)
Package: INR 59-65 lakhs per annum + variable components
Roles & Responsibilities:
Perform all First Officer duties with advanced responsibilities.
Act as PIC (where required) on select sectors.
Mentor and guide Trainee Pilots and First Officers.
Support Captain in flight management and operational decision-making.
Working Hours: Variable, scheduled as per flight operations; includes command on ultra-long-haul flights.
Location: Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru (assigned base)
Educational Qualifications:
Valid ATPL with PIC rating on Boeing 787 / Airbus A350 / A380
Total flying experience: 5000+ hours (2000+ hours as PIC on type)
Valid DGCA/ ICAO Medical Category 1
Package: INR 1.1 - 1.5 crores per annum + performance incentives, travel perks & leadership benefits
Roles & Responsibilities:
Command and supervise international flights ensuring utmost safety.
Decision making in all operational aspects, including emergencies.
Ensure compliance with all regulatory and company standards.
Lead and mentor cockpit and cabin crew.
Represent CloudWay 24 in audits and regulatory checks.

blocks.text:
Welcome to CloudWay 24 Careers!
Be part of one of India’s fastest-growing international carriers and help us keep the world connected, safe, and soaring. We are currently inviting talented and passionate engineers to join our dynamic Engineering Department.

items.text: Location: Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru (Based at our main hubs)
Working Hours: Shift-based (Including weekends & public holidays); 40-48 hours/week
Educational Qualifications:
B.E./B.Tech in Aeronautical/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering OR
DGCA-approved Aircraft Maintenance Engineer License (B1/B2)

Package:
₹8 – ₹18 LPA (Based on experience) + Annual Performance Bonus + Other Benefits
Roles & Responsibilities:
Perform routine and non-routine maintenance of Boeing 787 Dreamliner, Airbus A350, A380 fleet.
Conduct checks, troubleshooting, repairs, and certify aircraft before flight release.
Adhere to safety and regulatory compliance as per DGCA, EASA, FAA guidelines.
Coordinate with Technical Operations, Flight Crew, and OEMs for technical resolutions.
Oversee documentation and record-keeping per company and legal requirements.
Location: Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru
Working Hours: Rotational shifts; 40 hours/week
Educational Qualifications:
B.E./B.Tech in Avionics/Electronics Engineering
Preferably with DGCA / EASA Aircraft Maintenance License (B2 Category)

Package:
₹10 – ₹20 LPA + Allowances + Medical & Travel Benefits
Roles & Responsibilities:
Maintenance, troubleshooting and upgrades of avionics systems (navigation, communication, flight control, etc.).
Ensure optimum functioning of all electronic safety and operational equipment onboard.
Liaise with Airworthiness and Quality Assurance departments.
Innovate and implement new technology upgrades in coordination with OEMs.
Location: Mumbai (Head Office)
Working Hours: Standard (9 AM – 6 PM, Mon-Fri)
Educational Qualifications:
Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical/Industrial Engineering or similar
Proficient in AMOS or equivalent MRO software

Package:
₹6 – ₹13 LPA + Incentives
Roles & Responsibilities:
Provide technical and logistical support to line and base maintenance teams.
Maintain parts inventory, coordinate engineering resources for AOG (Aircraft On Ground) events.
Assist in engineering data analysis, technical documentation, and regulatory submissions.
Work closely with procurement and vendor management for spares and materials.

location.heading: Careers at CloudWay 24: Cabin Crew Recruitment

blocks.text: Are you ready to soar high and deliver world-class service above the clouds? Join the CloudWay 24 Cabin Crew and be an ambassador of seamless skies and global hospitality.

location.heading: Careers at CloudWay 24: Cabin Crew Recruitment

blocks.text: Cabin Crew Member

location.heading: Careers at CloudWay 24: Cabin Crew Recruitment

items.text: Roster-based Shifts: 8–12 hours per shift, including weekends, holidays, and overnight layovers.
Flexible Schedules: Aligned with international flight operations and layovers.

location.heading: Careers at CloudWay 24: Cabin Crew Recruitment

items.text: Primary Location: Mumbai, India (Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport)
Additional Base Locations: Delhi (Indira Gandhi International Airport) & Bengaluru (Kempegowda International Airport)
International layovers based on operational requirements.

location.heading: Careers at CloudWay 24: Cabin Crew Recruitment

items.text: Minimum 10+2 (Higher Secondary) from a recognized board.
Diploma / Degree in Hospitality, Travel, or Customer Service preferred (not mandatory).
Proficiency in English (spoken & written). Additional languages are an advantage.

location.heading: Careers at CloudWay 24: Cabin Crew Recruitment

items.text: Salary: INR 6–8 lakhs per annum (starting, based on experience & location)
Allowances: International layover allowance, flying allowance, and meal allowance.
Benefits: Medical & life insurance, comprehensive training, annual leave, free/reduced flight tickets (for self & family), and access to CloudWay 24 Lounges.
Incentives: Performance and service excellence bonuses.
Membership in the exclusive SkyPoints 24 Staff Rewards Program.

location.heading: Careers at CloudWay 24: Cabin Crew Recruitment

items.text: Passenger Safety: Ensure safety and security procedures are executed as per global aviation standards.
World-Class Service: Deliver premium in-flight service in all cabin classes—CloudLux, CloudElite, CloudComfort, and CloudSaver.
Pre-Flight Checks: Conduct safety checks before flight boarding.
Passenger Comfort: Assist passengers with seating, stowage of baggage, and comfort-related requests.
Emergency Handling: Professionally handle medical emergencies, turbulence, and evacuations if required.
Communication: Make announcements and communicate information clearly and efficiently.
Team Collaboration: Work harmoniously with the crew, flight deck, and ground teams.
Brand Representation: Uphold and embody the CloudWay 24 values—excellence, empathy, and professionalism at all times.
